judgment.rationale:
Evidence reveals two critical configuration change control failures for "churn-predictor-v1" / "churn-predictor-endpoint":

**Failure 1 — Initial Deployment (CreateEndpoint, 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z):**
The CloudTrail record (id: d7366d18) explicitly notes the endpoint was "Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00." The registry entry (id: f2782943) confirms approval occurred at 2025-12-01T09:00:00Z, while the endpoint was created at 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z. The evidence note embedded in the CloudTrail payload asserts the temporal ordering violates change control — the deployment preceded the formal approval gate, meaning the change was implemented before it was approved (CM-3.b and CM-3.d are violated: changes must be approved before implementation).

**Failure 2 — Hotfix Deployment (UpdateEndpoint, 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z):**
A second configuration change was deployed using config "churn-predictor-v1-hotfix" by the same IAM user (data-scientist-jdoe). The CloudTrail record (id: 4a4048fc) notes "no corresponding registry entry found." The model registry (id: f2782943) confirms only one entry exists (version 1, approved 2025-12-01), with no record of any approval for the hotfix configuration. This means a production configuration change was implemented with no documented approval, no security/privacy impact analysis, and no registry record — violating CM-3.b, CM-3.c, CM-3.d, and CM-3.e.

**Summary of violated sub-requirements:**
- CM-3.b: Proposed changes were not reviewed and approved before implementation.
- CM-3.c: Configuration change decisions were not documented (hotfix has no registry entry).
- CM-3.d: Unapproved changes were implemented in production.
- CM-3.e: No retention record exists for the hotfix change.
- CM-3.f: No evidence of monitoring/review activities for either change.

The control is not satisfied.
gaps: Human attestation needed to confirm whether an out-of-band approval process (e.g., JIRA ticket, change advisory board record) exists for the hotfix deployment that is not reflected in the model registry.
No evidence of a configuration change control policy document defining which change types are subject to CM-3 controls (CM-3.a).
No evidence of monitoring/review logs or audit reports covering these change events (CM-3.f).
No evidence of a configuration change control board or equivalent oversight body (CM-3.g).
Retention period policy for change records is not documented in available evidence (CM-3.e).
